# Standcast

> Standcast orchestrates a team daily standup from GitHub to Slack. Each person writes their daily with their AI agent, starting from a draft of their GitHub activity, and Standcast posts one digest per team to Slack. The public API is read-only; dailies are sent through the MCP server or the CLI.

## Documentation

- [Docs index for agents](https://docs-standcast.usefachada.dev/llms.txt): every documentation page as Markdown
- [Full docs in one file](https://docs-standcast.usefachada.dev/llms-full.txt): the whole documentation in a single file
